title: Best Time to Visit Jammu and Kashmir: Weather, Festivals & Tips
summary: Planning your trip? Here is the detailed weather calendar, seasonal breakdown, and festival guide for Jammu and Kashmir.
content: To truly experience the soul of Jammu and Kashmir, timing is everything. Whether you want to witness the grand Jammu and Kashmir Heritage Festival in November, ski on snowy peaks, or relax on golden sands, this monthly seasonal guide tells you when to book your tickets. We recommend visiting between October and March for cool, pleasant days, or exploring the lush green landscapes right after the monsoons.
